subject: acc
alt: Grade 11 learners understanding bank reconciliation showing cashbook balance, bank statement balance, outstanding deposits and unpresented cheques
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 11 learners showing a bank reconciliation. Display two columns: 'Cashbook' and 'Bank Statement' with arrows showing timing differences — an outstanding deposit (deposit in transit) flowing from cashbook to bank, and an unpresented cheque flowing from cashbook toward bank. Use a clean white background, blue and green colour scheme, simple flat design, and minimal text labels.

subject: acc
alt: Grade 11 learners understanding partnership structure showing two partners contributing capital and sharing profit through an appropriation process
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 11 learners showing how a partnership distributes profit. Show two partner figures (Partner A and Partner B) with capital contributions going into a shared business. Show an appropriation box in the centre distributing: interest on capital, salary allowances, and profit share to each partner. Use simple flat design, clean white background, and minimal text labels.

subject: acc
alt: Grade 11 learners seeing the flow from income statement through appropriation account to partner current accounts and balance sheet
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 11 learners showing the flow of financial statements for a partnership. Show a flowchart: Income Statement (net profit) → Appropriation Account → Partner A Current Account and Partner B Current Account → Balance Sheet (equity section). Use arrows to connect each box, bright distinct colours for each stage, clean white background, and minimal text labels.
